# Enetscores

> > Enetscores provides free, customizable livescore widgets powered by Enetpulse, delivering real-time sports data, statistics, and odds comparison across multiple sports.

Enetscores offers embeddable widgets for websites looking to display live sports scores and data. The platform supports various sports including football and American football, with comprehensive setup guides and customization options for developers and publishers.

## Key Topics

- Livescore widgets
- Enetpulse sports data
- Real-time scores
- Widget customization
- Multi-sport coverage
- Odds comparison
- Sports statistics
- Embeddable widgets
- Football livescores
- American football
- Free sports widgets
- Widget setup and integration
